summary: Special ID card for citizens aged 60 and above conferring bus travel concessions, healthcare queue priority, and legal aid.

steps.title: Age verification
steps.description: Provide passport, voter ID, matriculation certificate, or Aadhaar proving completion of 60 years.

steps.title: Medical blood group card
steps.description: Attach blood group report and emergency family doctor/next-of-kin contact details.

steps.title: Submit online or at Senior Citizen Home
steps.description: Register on state senior citizen portal or submit at municipal social welfare counter.

steps.title: Collect Senior Citizen Smart Card
steps.description: Download digital card or collect PVC laminated card with photo and blood group.
